readings.moment: When the temple struck nine, the master had everyone show their watches.
The hall clock downstairs struck ten while Ruedi was working in the atelier.
At the moment the hall clock struck ten, the regulator showed twelve minutes to ten.
When the temple struck ten, the regulator agreed with the bell exactly.
When the master sent Ruedi downstairs.
When the piano began, Ruedi looked at Rosa's clock.
When the piano stopped, Ruedi looked again at Rosa's clock.
The temple struck eleven, and Ruedi was still in the kitchen with Rosa until after it struck.

durations: Four years: the time the master spent working on the repeater.
13 minutes between the piano beginning (Rosa's clock at 10:58) and the piano stopping (Rosa's clock at 11:11).
whereabouts: At nine, when the temple struck, Ruedi was among those the master had show their watches.
After dinner, Ruedi went up to the atelier.
In the atelier, Ruedi worked beside the master at his bench.
The master was at his bench in the atelier with Ruedi until he sent her downstairs.
When the regulator showed 10:20, the master sent Ruedi downstairs.
Ruedi went straight down to the kitchen.
When the piano began, Ruedi was in the kitchen with Rosa.
Ruedi stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
Rosa was in the kitchen with Ruedi while the piano was playing.
That afternoon, Ruedi saw the master in the kitchen with Rosa's clock in his hands.
